title: 第五幕 お気に召すまま

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day has come to meet Fuji Kiseki's mother. We're waiting for her at a cafe she picked for us to go to.
choice_data_list: (I wonder what kind of person she is…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My mind begins to drift, but I'm abruptly startled from my thoughts by something odd.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why is the waiter singing?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if in response, the people around us all stand and start singing as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Musicians playing brass instruments join the show, then dancers, and finally…

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: "All the world's a stage, and all must play a role in it."

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: And mine… is your mother! Ah, long time no see, my daughter!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A beautiful Umamusume who looks just like an adult version of Fuji Kiseki appears before us.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Long time no see, Mother! Sorry, Trainer. I forgot to tell you, but my mother has a bad habit of surprising people.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Calling the kettle black now, are you, dear? So, you're Fuji's trainer. Nice to meet you, and thank you for looking after her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I didn't expect my first meeting with Fuji Kiseki's mother to be so theatrical, yet here we are!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: I see. So, essentially, you want to know how to get over stage fright?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Yes. I was hoping you could tell me since I've never seen you get scared on stage before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Why, that's… That's just… Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Oh, my dear, I do get scared on stage, though!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Ah… Sorry for laughing so hard. Why, right before the flash mob performance started, I was unbelievably nervous.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: I wanted to put on a perfect show since it's my first time meeting your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: But I was equally terrified I would fail. It would've been a terrible first impression if I did.
choice_data_list: I couldn't tell you were nervous at all!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: That's because you're an audience member. I can't possibly show you any signs of weakness!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Does that mean you're always scared when you perform, just like me?

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Of course, love.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: S-Seriously?! I had no idea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki's mother smiles faintly at her shocked exclamation.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Theater is a living art! There are times when things go well, there are times when they don't. I am no stranger to criticism and despair.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: I invoke positive and negative feelings in my audiences in equal parts.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: So long as you are an entertainer upon a stage, that is simply how things are.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: I merely did my very best not to show that side of myself to you. I had to save face before you as your mother, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: But now that I understand your woes, there is somewhere I'd like to bring you. Come with me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes us in front of a train station, where a billboard for the autumn Tenno Sho with a large photo of Fuji Kiseki herself stands above the bustling crowds.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: I've been keeping tabs on how you've been doing. I know of the challenge you've taken on, as well as your acclaim in the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: So, when you contacted me, I suddenly realized what was wrong. You must feel like you're at the end of your rope, yes?

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: You must be worried about if you can meet everyone's expectations—if you're even worthy of such high hopes. I know how you feel. I've been there.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: …Of course you already knew. I should've just asked you from the start.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki cranes her neck to look up at the billboard version of herself smiling a fierce and daring grin.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Mother? What should I do if I fail? What should I do about all the people I'll end up disappointing?

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Nothing. There's nothing you can do.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: An entertainer can do no more than perform. How the audience decides to accept your performance is up to them.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Once an actor descends from the stage, there is nothing they can say to their audience.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: For example, even if I hounded you two earlier and kept asking you if you enjoyed my show…

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: It wouldn't have changed how you really felt about my performance, right? It's just like that!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I… I suppose that's true…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki seems reluctant to accept the advice, and her mother smiles at her fondly.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Whether we succeed or fail, all we can do is our best to move forward, dear.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: That is what you must accept in your heart in order rise before a crowd.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I have to… accept that I can only do my best…

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: I'm not privy to the minute details of your worries, but I have a feeling what you lack now is determination.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Your dread of disappointing others stems from a desire to protect yourself.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Right now, you fear losing your self-worth more than you are determined to become a good entertainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: You'll never be able to become an entertainer that properly delights her audience with that attitude.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Look. So many people are taking pictures of your billboard and smiling as they look at it and talk about you.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Now think—what is it that you ought to do now?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After parting with her mother, Fuji Kiseki goes into a rare state of despondency.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I'm glad you're here with me. Truly, the best advice is also the hardest to swallow.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But thanks to her, I've realized something!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: When I was still an actor, I only ever worried about what she thought of me and what others thought when they compared me to her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, she poured her heart and soul single-mindedly into her art. There was no way I could win against her like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A small sigh escapes from her lips.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ever since I started my senior year, I haven't been able to focus on my races like before.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I've just been becoming increasingly worried about how to fix things if I mess up…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And the more I thought about that, the more stressed I became. If only I'd been able to concentrate, I wouldn't have gotten to this state.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: With the way I am now, there's no way I can become the greatest entertainer…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If I want to win over everyone who's watching me, then I can't worry about getting hurt.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: One can't become the world's greatest entertainer without being prepared to fail trying!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite the harsh truth she must still be grappling with, Fuji Kiseki looks like a huge weight has been lifted off her shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I feel like I finally understand! I'm still terrified of the remaining stages I have ahead…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: But I get the feeling that, so long as I can overcome this, I can take another step forward.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There is a slight tightness in Fuji Kiseki's confident smile, but…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I'll be able to do it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's something I've always known from the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Behold, a star befitting of your grace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Behold, a star befitting of your grace!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's that Fuji Kiseki is just like the evening star, more fascinating and alluring that any other twinkle in the night sky.
choice_data_list: For you are a star brighter than anything in the world.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I'm a star, huh? I guess you're right.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You really do know me too well!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her blue eyes begin to sparkle with a mischievous light, just like they did that day long ago.
